justification: User authorized continuous research on 2026-10-27. Daily plan attempts are separately capped; preserve the existing prospective windows, criteria, costs and historical allowances.

plan_template.justification: Preregister comparison and a single final after review. Minimum three-day comparison and seven-day final are pilot allocations, extended deterministically to cover declared blocks; future data and passage gates remain necessary.

criteria.dependence_justification: Chosen pilot hour blocks, extended to causal footprint; descriptive block uncertainty does not prove independence or exhaust regime diversity. Freeze before prospective observations; never lower these gates after seeing results.

continuous_plan_allowance.justification: At most one newly preregistered prospective plan per UTC day and two pending evaluations, without resetting historical plans or reusing a held-out period.
